procedural_matters: ITA was represented by Enrico Coslovich.
BRA was represented by Zion Brandao da Cunha Faria.
Juan Sienra (coach of BRA) and Alessandra Sensini (coach of ITA) attended the hearing as observers.
ITA and BRA provided tracking evidence.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: After rounding mark 1 the second time, ITA on starboard tack with full gennaker sailing downwind on a speed at 10-12 kts, on the port side layline.
BRA sailing upwind, slightly below close-hauled course on port tack, 1 boat lengths over the port side layline at speed of 8 kts, boats sailing towards each other.
4 boat lengths after rounding the mark and when the distance between the boats was 8 boat lengths, ITA luffed slightly.
At the same time BRA luffed.
ITA passed 0,5 boat lengths leeward of BRA.
conclusions: BRA on port tack kept clear of ITA on starboard tack and did not break RRS 10.
